name: v4.0.534
body:
## What's Changed

- **Upgrade to Chromium 157.0.8080.0** by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11460
- `@remotion/renderer`: [**Share memory between Chrome and FFmpeg**](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/shared-memory-capture)
- `@remotion/renderer`: [**Enable parallel encoding more often**](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/parallel-encoding)
- `remotion`: [**Nested HTML-in-canvas works during server-side rendering**](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/remotion/html-in-canvas#htmlincanvasisnestingsupported)
- `remotion`: Skip unchanged timeline sequence updates by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12030
- `remotion`: Fix unnecessary context updates in `<Freeze>` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12039
- `@remotion/animation-utils`: Apply easing to colors in `interpolateStyles()` by @sarmah-rup in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12043
- `@remotion/cloudrun`: Check for missing credentials by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12048
- `@remotion/codemods`: Fix Pre-compose for `Series.Sequence` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11969
- `@remotion/codemods`: Pre-compose single roots with `Interactive.withSchema()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12004
- `@remotion/eslint-config-flat`: Disable `no-use-before-define` in user presets by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11976
- `@remotion/lambda-client`: Use constant-time comparison for webhook signatures by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12035
- `@remotion/media`: Preserve original errors from format detection by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11984
- `@remotion/media`: Fix duplicate timeline layers when `<Video>` falls back by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12034
- `@remotion/renderer`: Remove free-memory check for parallel encoding by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11971
- `@remotion/renderer`: Mux audio-only AAC into .m4a, .m4b and .3gp containers by @PRIEST099 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11977
- `@remotion/renderer`: Mux `separateAudioTo` AAC into .m4a, .m4b and .3gp containers by @HEOJUNFO in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12014
- `@remotion/renderer`: Warn about unsupported AAC output extensions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11990
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix available memory estimates on macOS and Linux by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12009
- `@remotion/renderer`: Accept uppercase output file extensions by @theluckystrike in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12020
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix media rendering failures after `delayRender()` retries by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12033
- `@remotion/renderer`: Do not log "Target closed" from tab cycling during teardown by @onlined in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12037
- `@remotion/studio`: Add upgrade and action menu for Agent Skills by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11980
- `@remotion/studio`: Add seconds and timecode input for composition duration by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11975
- `@remotion/studio`: Shortcut for matching duration to timeline by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11983
- `@remotion/studio`: Follow active caption in inspector by @snowyukitty in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11965
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix `staticFile()` assets after server restarts by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11962
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix unnecessary dropdown renders on resize by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11978
- `@remotion/studio`: Keep right sidebar open at narrower widths by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11979
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix subscription churn when trimming parent sequences by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11991
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix left edge trimming inside trimmed sequences by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11992
- `@remotion/studio`: Add ChatGPT annotations to source and repair actions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11993
- `@remotion/studio`: Check wrap eligibility only on click by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11998
- `@remotion/studio`: Remove idle tooltip and context menu listeners by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11999
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix blank screen when project imports fail by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12000
- `@remotion/studio`: Remember recent editor and coding agent choices by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12001
- `@remotion/studio`: Remove idle action work on frame changes by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12002
- `@remotion/studio`: Keep one visible frame when trimming clipped sequences by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12007
- `@remotion/studio`: Add agent guidance to server disconnect banner by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12008
- `@remotion/studio`: Reduce unnecessary renders for editing actions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12010
- `@remotion/studio`: Align icons to the pixel grid by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12013
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix editing `fps` expressions in files with multiple components by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12016
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix wrapper selection after HTML-in-canvas and Motion blur actions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12017
- `@remotion/studio`: Reduce unnecessary canvas and timeline renders by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12028
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix waveform peak sampling when zooming or trimming by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12032
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix canvas tabs scrollbar track contrast by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12038
- `@remotion/studio`: Hide redundant canvas wrapping quick actions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12047
- `@remotion/studio`: Remove waveform peak scaling when showing volume curves by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12050
- `@remotion/studio`: Skip saving unchanged props on blur by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12052
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Open VS Code source files in project workspace by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11966
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix effects and radial gradients in client-side rendering by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12019
- `create-video`: Add bundled and individual skill installation choices by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11956
- `create-video`: Tailwind disabled by default, use `--tailwind` to add TailwindCSS by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12055

## Elements

- Insert gallery elements without outer Sequences by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11853
- Add visible Browser Studio action to detail pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11856
- Rename audio visualizer `audioSrc` props to `src` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12003

## Docs

- [remotion.dev/options](https://remotion.dev/docs/options) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12029
- Avoid renumbering option pages when adding options by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12058
- Clarify stacking order in client-side rendering by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12045
- Document botocore configuration for `RemotionClient()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12046
- Clamp both sides in `interpolate()` range example by @adityapratap0077-cloud in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12044
- Add Faceless Shorts Kit to resources by @developk in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11986
- Add descriptor to Faceless Shorts Kit listing by @developk in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12031
- Add remotion-qa to resources (Tooling) by @GroMarketing in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12011

## Internal and Experimental

- `remotion`: Prototype `<Track>` for single-row Studio timelines by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11854
- Skills: Prefer built-in effects for supported components by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11968
- Skills: Fix caption timing guidance for edited clips by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11970
- Skills: Use inline `volume` interpolation in examples by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11981
- Skills: Add Canvas Capture import via `experimental-codemod` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12012
- Run independent CI setup steps in parallel by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12057

## New Contributors

- @snowyukitty made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11965
- @theluckystrike made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12020

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.533...v4.0.534
